The '''Zanbar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalore sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] which contained the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Zanbar/Legends|Zanbar]].
